title: 2021 Topps #US203 Trevor May New York Mets Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps Update Base trading card featuring Trevor May of the New York Mets. It is part of the MLB baseball league and is an original single card manufactured by Topps. This card is part of the base set for the 2021 season, showcasing May as a player for the Mets. It is a valuable collectible for fans of baseball trading cards.
